LanguageData.TwitchChat_RepickDescr: Gives a new random chat-name to this Pawn
LanguageData.TwitchChat_PickChatterDescr: Pick a Twitch chatter from a searchable list to link to this pawn.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_RemoveLinkDescr: Not happy with the linked user? End it here.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_AnonNote: No Twitch account, token or login needed. The mod reads chat anonymously (read-only). Just enter a channel below.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_ChannelDesc: The channel whose chat to read: the name only, not the full URL. No login or token needed; the mod reads chat anonymously.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_HintNoChannel: Enter the channel whose chat you want to read to get started.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_HintConnecting: Contacting Twitch… this usually takes a few seconds.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_HintDisconnected: Click Test connection to connect. If it fails, check the channel name is spelled correctly and that you're online.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_TestConnectionDesc: Wait a few seconds after clicking. If the status stays "Not connected", recheck the fields above.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Nudge_SetChannel: Twitch Chat: set a channel in Mod Options → Twitch Chat to start naming pawns after your chat.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_NamingIntro: The mod tracks recently active chatters and gives their names to eligible pawns.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_NameOther: Name raiders, mechs, insects and visitors
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_NameOtherOn: Raiders, mechs, insects and visitors get named after chatters.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_NameOtherOff: Raiders, mechs, insects and visitors keep their default names.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_NameWildOn: Wild animals on the map get named after chatters.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_NameWildOff: Wild animals keep their default names.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_NameTameOn: Your tamed animals get named after chatters, existing ones too, not just new.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_NameTameOff: Your tamed animals keep their own names.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_Reuse: Allow the same name on more than one pawn
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_ReuseOn: A chatter name can be reused across pawns (e.g. an animal and a raider).
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_ReuseOff: Each chatter name is used on at most one pawn.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_PoolSizeDesc: How many recent chatters to keep for naming and the picker.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_ShowBubblesOn: Chatters' messages appear above the pawn they're linked to.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_ShowEmotesOn: Twitch, 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes are drawn in the bubbles.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_ShowEmotesOff: Emotes show as their text instead of images.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_BubbleDurationDesc: How long each speech bubble stays on screen (1 to 60 seconds).
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_IgnoreBotsOn: Known service bots (Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot…) are never named or shown.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_IgnoreBotsOff: Chat bots are treated like any other chatter.
LanguageData.TwitchChat_Set_BlacklistDesc: These users are ignored for naming and bubbles.
